conventions.solution: Field fix text. Present only where a human wrote one. Empty string means NOT YET WRITTEN, never 'no fix exists'.
conventions.lineage: PV only, and both are kept. 'extension-inv3000id' is the packed bitfield view (registers 3096-3105, 3472-3474). 'tauri-s6' is the DISCRETE-INPUT view of the same faults (2501-2580) and is document-confirmed: 55 of its 56 labels match the PDFs exactly, the one miss being the document abbreviating 'Under Temperature PRO'. They are two views, not rival maps.
conventions.doc_confirms: tauri-s6 rows only. True when the label matches the document's name for that discrete input.
conventions.reserved: Reserved/blank bits are dropped unless they carry a solution.
conventions.pv_solutions: No PV solution text exists in any app or PDF. All 11 PV Modbus PDFs were searched; every hit is 'Resolution'.
